name: ModelVariant670_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant670_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (textured shells grow from a model point one after another, each a sprite with a meshed dome on an eight-point base, and each hands a spinning ring band with a square flash to the same spot); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-687 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant687_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
